\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{tikz}
\usetikzlibrary{datavisualization}
\makeatletter
\tikzdatavisualizationset{every ticks/.append style={node style={
  name=nativetick,
  append after command={\pgfextra{
    \pgf@process{\pgfpointanchor{nativetick}{center}}%
    \typeout{DV-NODE \ProbeName: \tikz@dv@tick@pos; \the\pgf@x,\the\pgf@y}%
  }}
}}}
\let\NativeComputeTicks\tikz@lib@dv@compute@at@linear
\def\tikz@lib@dv@compute@at@linear{%
  \NativeComputeTicks
  \typeout{DV-TICKS \ProbeName: \pgfkeysvalueof{/tikz/data visualization/major}}%
  \typeout{DV-MINOR \ProbeName: \pgfkeysvalueof{/tikz/data visualization/minor}}%
}
\makeatother
\newcommand\Probe[3]{%
  \def\ProbeName{#1}%
  \tikz \datavisualization[scientific axes=clean,#2,visualize as line]
  #3;\par
}
\begin{document}
\Probe{positive}{}{data point[x=10,y=20] data point[x=20,y=25]}
\Probe{negative}{}{data point[x=-20,y=-25] data point[x=-10,y=-20]}
\Probe{single}{}{data point[x=7,y=3]}
\Probe{phase}{all axes={ticks={step=.5,phase=.25}}}{data point[x=-1,y=-1] data point[x=1,y=1]}
\Probe{epsilon}{all axes={ticks={step=.5}}}{data point[x=.0005,y=.0005] data point[x=.9995,y=.9995]}
\Probe{outside}{all axes={ticks={step=.5}}}{data point[x=.002,y=.002] data point[x=.998,y=.998]}
\Probe{minor}{x axis={ticks={minor steps between steps=4}}}{data point[x=.049787,y=0] data point[x=20.0855,y=9]}
\Probe{zero-to-two}{}{data point[x=0,y=0] data point[x=2,y=2]}
\Probe{noninteger}{}{data point[x=0,y=0] data point[x=6,y=2.47]}
\end{document}
